# Move Player To Team

Source: [wiki article 4540](../archive/4540.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Move Player To Team](../../api/actions/move-player-to-team.md).

<a id="wiki-4540-n1"></a>

- Move Player To Team fails if the slot is unavailable and does not work on dummy bots; -1 means first available slot.

<a id="wiki-4540-n2"></a>

- All is for FFA and explicit team values for team modes.
